blocks.x: We’re going to take a minute or two. So when we take a break we’ll come back, talk about that. I’d like to also talk about the Barron brothers. I want to make sure we get that.
Yeah. It was all about Bill. Bill was our mentor. Bill Barron was something. People don’t know.
But they’re going to know now, because you’re going to tell them.
All right. On that note we’ll come back.
This is tape two of the Benny Golson oral history interview. When we last left off we’re still in Philadelphia. We haven’t got out of Philly. We don’t need to get out of there. No

rush. We’re talking about some of the families that are still closely associated with this great city. We were talking about the Heath brothers. Then we were talking about the Barron brothers. So if you can help the next generations to understand just how important these people were to this music.
